tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zla gsang las sku gzugs dbang po skyon sbyang rab gnas kyi cho ga'i lhan thabs

bzhugs so// ya mā ri na mo/ 'dir zla gsang las sku gzugs dbang po skyon sbyangs rab gnas kyi cho ga'i lhan thabs arga'i cho ga la gnyis/ rten gsar la bya ba dang*/ rnying pa la bya ba'o// dang po gsar pa la bya ba ni/ rgyu bzo bo rab tu gnas pa'o// de la ni/ dus dang gza' skar shis pa la bab pa'i tshe mchod gtor rgyas par bshams/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs skyabs sems dang*/ ma rig rgyu sogs kyis snying rje rnam gsum gsal btab rjes/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa'i mthar thug pa byas la thun bsdus te phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pas| rten gyi rgyu dang bzo bo mdun du bkod par sbyang ba dang*/ bgegs bskrad/ khrus gsol rnams ci rigs pa rab gnas gzhung ltar byas rjes/ de dag las gshin gyi sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la/ sku 'dra bris 'bur yin na/ sku 'bag gi rgyu dang bzo bo hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog nag po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ zhes sogs/ gsung rab yin na/ pad nyi'i gdan la shog bu dang 'bri mkhan hrīḥlas padma dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas padma dang*/ zhes sogs/ mchod rten yin na/ pad nyi'i gdan la mchod rten gyi rgyu dang bzo bo buṃ las 'khor lo bum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo/ zhes sogs/ de dag thams cad thun mong du/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhengs pa'i pang du rang 'dra'i yum gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'i spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/

mgrin par padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams su gyur par bsam/ de nas spyan drang rgyas gdab pa/ sta gon dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'dir rgyas gdab kyi sngon 'dir dbang bskur mdor bsdus shig bya dgos so// mchan/ mchod cing bstod pa/ gtor ma gtang ba rnams sku gzugs dbang po skyon sbyang rab gnas kyi cho ga'i sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas rjes/ sku 'dra'i rgyu dang bzo bo yin na/ oṃ de wa sha ya mā ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ gsung rab kyi rgyu dang 'bri mkhan yin na/ oṃ rā ga ya mā ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ mchod rten gyi rgyu dang bzo bo yin na/ oṃ mo ha sha ya mā ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams skabs bstun gyis ci 'grub bzla/ de rjes mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang 'byor byas rjes/ pus btsugs lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas spos thogs g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang gi lce hūm̐ las gyur pa'i rdo rjer gyur par bsam pas/ 'jam pa'i khro bo bcom ldan 'das/ zhes pa nas/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi bar brjod/ snyan gsan sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas rjes/ rab gnas nangs par zhes pa'i mal du sku 'dra dang*/ mchod rten yin na/ 'bur sku la/ sku brnyan nangs par bgyi bar 'tshal/ zhes dang*/ bris sku yin na/ bris sku nangs par zhes dang*| mchod rten yin na/ mchod rten nangs par bgyi zhes dang*/ gsung rab yin na/ gsung rab nangs par bri zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab/ slar mchod cing bstod nas/ yig brgyas bzod par gsol nas| oṃ badzra muḥ rgyu cha dang bzo bo'i ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa dang rgyu cha dang bzo bo'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ bzo bo'am 'bri mkhan gyi lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa re rer zhu ba rdo rje lag pa la thim pas rdo rje'i lag pa/

sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje rtse gcig pa re re'i rnam par gyur/ bzo bo'am 'bri mkhan gyi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying gar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur par bsam pas de'i gnas gsum du rdo rjes reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la bsrung*/ gsung rab yin na/ shog bu rnams dhīḥyig tu gyur pa las 'od 'phros/ gsung rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i rnam par spyan drangs/ shog bu la thim pas byin gyis brlab par gyur par bsams la dbyangs gsal ci 'grub bzlas/ sku 'dra'i tshon rtsi dang*/ gsung rab kyi gser/ dngul/ mtshal dang snag tsha sogs dang*/ bzo bo'i lag cha tho skam pir smyug sogs la/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐ dang las gshin gyi sngags ci 'grub bzlas rjes/ lag cha rnams shes rab stong pa nyid ye shes kyi bdag nyid dang*/ tshon rtsi gser dngul mtshal snag tsha sogs/ rdo rje'i rdul phra rab yongs su gyur pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ oṃ dhīḥshru ti smṛ ti bi dza ya sarba ādzñā na pa ṭa ma a pa ha ri ṇ-i hrīḥswā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas rjes/ yi ge brgya pa bsnyen par byas nas ye dharma dang shis brjod ci rigs bya/ bzo bo dang dge 'dun la chos ston drangs shing gza' skar bab pa na rten 'bri bzhengs kyi dbu 'dzugs par bya zhing*/ rgyu'i byin rlabs 'di grub nas rten 'bri bzhengs ma 'gyang ba de ma thag tu bya ba gal che'o// gnyis pa rten rnying pa la bya ba arga'i cho ga ni/ arga zhes pa rin thang la 'jug pas gtso bo rten gyi rgyu ngan pa bzang du gtong ba la bya/ gzhan yang 'o brgyal ba'i gnas nas mi brgyal ba'i gnas su spo ba ni/ nang bzhugs nor 'khrul byung ba legs par btsas pa dang chud zos pa brje ba dang*/ rten 'jig la khad pa zhig gso bya ba sogs la bya yang*/

rten la 'dre gdon ma rungs pas bdag gir byas pa la ni sngags pa nus ldan gyis bgyir rung la nus med kyis ni ma yin no// gzhan rang 'dod kyis rten bris 'bur gyi rgyu bzang po la brje bo dang*/ nang bzhugs khyad par can dmar rngams kyi phyir arga byas na ni nye ba'i mtshams med kyi las yin no// de ltar nges par byas nas lag len ni/ rten de dag gi mdun du gtor mchod bshams/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs skyabs sems/ ma rig rgyu sogs snying rje rnam gsum gsal gdab/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa'i mthar thug par byas rjes thun bsdus nas phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ arga bya yul gyi rten de nyid la mchod bstod rgyas par bya/ chos skyong dang rten de dag gi srung ma dang gzhi bdag la gtor ma phul bka' bsgo bya/ bdag gis sems can gyi don du rten 'di dag rgyu dman pa bzang por bsgyur ba'am/ 'o brgyal ba'i gnas 'di nas 'o mi brgyal ba'i gnas gzhan du spo ba'am/ zhig pa gso ba'am/ nang bzhugs brje ba'am/ gdon dang phral ba sogs dgos pa che ge mo'i slad du rab gnas spo bar bya'o snyam du bsams la/ rdor dril spos dang bcas pas/ lce hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur par mos la/ rig pa'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan dbye ba// kun gyis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir// bdag ni che ge rdo rje yis// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// yo byad ci 'byor ba dag gis// rab gnas nangs par spo bar bgyi// tshogs pa thams cad rab gnas pa// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis snyan gsan dbab/ mchod bstod bya/ nangs par mchod pa gsar pa bshams/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgoms la bsdus te phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis rten la mchod cing bstod nas/

rten gyi mdun du me long g.ya' dag pa bzhag pa rten gyi gzugs brnyan me long la 'char bar byas la/ rang gi thugs ka nas lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer spros nas rten de'i lha dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa tha mi dad pa spyan drangs me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan la thim par gyur par bsam pas/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa tha mi dad du skad cig gis me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ de ma thag rten rnying pa la khebs g.yogs/ me long nang gi lha la yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ rten 'brel snying po dang*/ su pra tiṣṭhas brtan par bya/ mchod bstod gtor 'bul rgyas par byas rjes/ oṃ badzra wast+ra hūm̐/ zhes me long dar ser pos dril la rgyab phyogs su mdud cing rgyas btab/ mgo mjug mi log pa'i mtshan ma byas la dben par mchod pa dang bcas bzhugs su gsol/ rten rnying pa'i rgyu rnams gsar pa la bsre'am/ mi 'os na chu bor dor ram/ lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten bzhengs la rab tu gnas/ shing las byas pa ni zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ rten rnying pa'i rgyu nas cung zad cig gsar pa la nges par bsre/ lhag ma rnams skye bos longs mi spyad par bya/ gdon gyis bdag gir byas pa dag gi rnying pa'i rgyu gsar par mi bsre bar rnying pa rnams drag po'i sbyin sreg bya'o// de nas rten gsar pa la sngar las rgyu tshad mi dman pa grub nas/ rab gnas dngos bzhi'i lha bskyed pa grub nas spyan 'dren gyi snga rol du me long rten gyi mdun du khyer ba zhal khebs bshus la mchod cing bstod nas/ me long nang gi lha dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa tha mi dad du rten gsar pa la skad cig gis bstims nas/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ me long dben par sbas la/

slar rab gnas kyi ye shes pa spyan drang ba sogs cho ga dkyus ltar byas pas yang dag par grub pa yin no// zhes pa 'di ni zla gsang las sku gzugs dbang po skyon sbyang rab gnas kyi cho ga'i lhan thabs su arga'i cho ga nyid kyang med mi rung bas yan lag yin phyir bris pa yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
